stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: In a field log, a coordinator records the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: Use the imparfait to match the reporting verb in the past
options.misconception: mistakes a surface feature of "Use the imparfait to match the reporting verb…" for the governing rule

options.text: Use the present tense because the statement is still true today
options.misconception: confuses reported time with present fact

options.text: Use the conditionnel to show a future seen from the past
Use the passe compose to mark a completed action
options.misconception: mixes completed action with future reference

questions.explanation: Reported future events take the conditionnel. The present ignores the past reporting frame, and imparfait wrongly flattens the future into an ongoing past.
questions.hint: Think of a future viewed from a past moment.

questions.stem: During a quality review, a coordinator records the evidence: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

answer.exemplar: In an indirect question the subject comes before the verb, so 'ou est le quai' becomes 'ou le quai est', dropping the inversion of direct speech.
